description: This file defines a report for vehicle expenses in ERPNext, including functions to generate report columns, fetch vehicle log data, compute expenses, and prepare chart data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate vehicle expenses report data and chart.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the vehicle expenses report.

methods.name: get_vehicle_log_data
methods.description: Fetches vehicle log data within specified date range and filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_period_dates
methods.description: Determines start and end dates based on filters.

methods.name: get_service_expense
methods.description: Calculates total service expense for a vehicle log.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for expense trend chart.
